//: MCP server registry, in the exact `.mcp.json` schema the `mcp` pi-extension reads (~/opencode/pi-extensions/extensions/mcp). The loop harness points that extension at the toolbox (installs this as ~/.pi/agent/mcp.json via PI_AGENT_DIR) and a stage reaches these servers by putting `mcp` in its tools allowlist. NOT used by PROJ-1487 — present so the advertised toolbox tree is complete. NB: the mcp extension defaults every server OFF each session (curate via the /mcp panel), so a headless stage that needs one must have it pre-enabled. Env values support ${VAR} / $env:VAR expansion; secrets never live inline.
